pullRequests.title: feat: extract and build every level from both discs, recount functions from the binaries
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: feat/pal-levels
pullRequests.body:
Levels pulled out of the discs properly, every program built byte-identical, and the functions recounted from the binaries. No matching in here, just restructure.
Both discs

tools/levels.py dump reads the main program and all 49 programs (main image, frontbin, 47 levels) straight from the ISO's table of contents. No wrench unpack needed.
tools/build_levels.py rebuilds every program from its assembly and checks it against the disc: 49/49 MATCH on US (SCUS_974.65) and on PAL (SCES_532.85).
US is…

pullRequests.title: fix(match_map): count new C under US catalogue names
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/new-us-names
pullRequests.body: New C for functions the old US lists never had (the holes in the menu text, frontbin, level code) now maps straight to its US catalogue place, like src/pal/ does on PAL. The audit skips those names and says so, and reads level code from the US dumps when private/overlays isn't there. No count changes on main.

pullRequests.title: feat: match 463 small functions
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: batch/b1-small-functions
pullRequests.body:
463 two-instruction functions: empty bodies, constant returns, single loads and stores through $gp or an argument. All of them were in the holes the old function list never cut, or in level code it counted as one. Each one checked with tools/check_func.py and the stock flags, and match in config/us/map.tsv.
US: 2,480 of 18,085 functions (3.71% code, fuzzy 4.19%). PAL: 2,435 of 18,113 (3.53%).

pullRequests.title: feat: match 425 small functions from machine drafts
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: batch/b2-machine-drafts
pullRequests.body:
425 functions where the m2c draft, cleaned to plain C, already builds to the US bytes with the stock flags (call wrappers, field getters and setters, small leaf functions). Drafts that hardcode a global's address were left out. Each is match in config/us/map.tsv.
The legacy audit now reports two names as not exact: func_00547A98 and func_L01_004F3100. The old function lists cut them too short (36 and 28 bytes). The catalogue sizes are 44 and 36, and the C matches those.
US: 2,905 of 18,085…

pullRequests.title: feat: match 68 small functions from machine drafts
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: batch/b3-m2c-externs
pullRequests.body:
m2c drafts again, this time with $gp-relative and absolute addresses turned into extern globals (D_XXXXXXXX) instead of hardcoded addresses. Each one builds to the US bytes with the stock flags and shows match in config/us/map.tsv.
The legacy audit now also flags func_00161890: the old list gave it 160 bytes, but the catalogue cuts it at 32, and the C matches those 32.
US: 2,973 of 18,085 functions.

pullRequests.title: feat: match 14 more functions, stage closer near misses
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: batch/b4-held-and-permuter
pullRequests.body:
13 m2c drafts held back from #21 because they hardcoded addresses: the addresses are now extern globals (unsized arrays where retail loads through lui), or the 0x constants turned out to be masks, not addresses.
func_004E7638 from the permuter: statement order and one temporary.
21 near misses in nonmatching/ replaced by closer permuter results (tools/nonmatching.py stage only keeps a result that is closer), and func_004E7638 dropped from nonmatching/.

All matches pass tools/check_func.py with…

pullRequests.title: Add PAL versions of 16 functions whose US C differs on PAL (src/pal/)
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: pal-oficial
pullRequests.body:
These are differs rows of config/pal/map.tsv listed in docs/levels.md: the US C in src/ builds only to the US bytes. Each file here is the US C with the constants that table lists changed to the PAL values (50 Hz timings, 25/30 frame counts, a float 50.0 against 60.0, animation ids), named after the PAL function. Every one gives MATCH with
tools/check_func.py --version pal NAME file.c on SCES_532.85 (checked with the final files), and a deliberately wrong constant gives BYTES.
Not done here,…

pullRequests.title: Add PAL C for the remaining 16 `differs` functions; use PAL callee names in src/pal/
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: pal-oficial-2
pullRequests.body:
This finishes the docs/levels.md table of US functions that differ on PAL: with these 16 every row has PAL C in src/pal/.
7 functions whose PAL twin differs only by constants or global offsets
func_004F6660, func_L00_00599F58, func_L00_006BB798, func_L00_007158A0, func_L00_00718458, func_L01_0055B6A8, func_L41_003DFDA0. These are 50 Hz timings (×5/6), shifted globals and one hardcoded address. Globals are named after the PAL address their instructions reach: HI16/LO16 pairs, and $gp = 0x2259FF…
